text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PAGER FIRED (P1) - metering.ingest.token-delta > alert_threshold for multiple customers. Trigger: tokens_count != ledger_tokens for customer ACME. Links: https://pagerduty.example/incident/PD12345 :rotating_light:

alice.oncall: Acked. I'm looking. Paging oncall SRE + billing. Repro steps?

ben.sre: Oncall here. Seeing spike in kafka consumer lag on metering-ingest (partition 12-18). `consumer_lag > 50000` for 3m. Also higher retry rate on de-dup worker.

carla.billing: Noted. Finance: invoices for this week include ACME. If token counts are inflated we may under/over-bill. Need freeze on invoice generation until we understand scope.

dave.ingest: Rapid note: there was a deploy ~40m ago that touched dedupe microservice (v2.9.1). Rolling back now to v2.8.7 to rule that out. Command: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/dedupe dedupe=registry/redwood/dedupe:v2.8.7`

alice.oncall: Good call. Also adding temporary circuit: set feature flag `metering.skip_forwarding=true` for ACME shard to stop more bad events flowing downstream.

ben.sre: Metrics: `tokens_ingested_total` jumped +120% after 11:03 UTC. Ledger writes (billing_ledger.tokens) did not increase at same rate -> mismatch. Query I ran: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metering.events WHERE time > now() - 1h GROUP BY customer` shows anomalous shape for ACME.

carla.billing: Can we get list of customers affected? Finance needs a list to pause invoice runs.

dave.ingest: Quick grep of topic shows many duplicate message IDs. Looks like dedupe index not persisting; local cache eviction bug. Example log: ```ERROR dedupe: keyExists check failed: cache miss for id=abc1234 after write```

ben.sre: Confirmed. Consumer acks were happening before dedupe write ack due to reordered commits in our consumer loop. Patch idea: add commit-after-dedupe flag. Meanwhile I'm throttling commit rate and bumping `max.poll.records` down.

alice.oncall: Carla @carla.billing I suspended scheduled invoice job for today. Please confirm when safe to resume.

carla.billing: Thanks. Confirmed suspended. We'll wait for a clean backfill and reconciliation report.

erin.pm: Escalate to Eng Manager if rollback doesn't stabilize in 15m. Customer comms ready: short message saying 'we are investigating token accounting discrepancy; no invoices will be charged until reconciliation complete'.

ben.sre: Rollback to v2.8.7 completed at 11:27 UTC. Initial telemetry: consumer_lag dropping, duplicate IDs rate falling from 18% -> 3% in 6m.

dave.ingest: Starting backfill job: `backfill_ingest --from 11:00 --to now --customer acme --dedupe-mode=strong` Running on batch node bg-12. Pls monitor CPU + egress.

alice.oncall: Handing off to ben for next hour. Ben, you own until 12:30 UTC. I'll update incident when I return.

ben.sre: Ack handoff. Will monitor and run reconciliation checks. Plan: run reconciliation query against ledger every 5m and generate delta report. If delta > 2% escalate to manager + billing execs.

carla.billing: FYI finance requested early reconciliation CSV. Ben, can you drop results to `#billing-ops` when ready?

ben.sre: Will do. First delta snapshot: ACME tokens_ingested=1,245,678 vs ledger=1,001,234 -> delta +24.3%. Uploading CSV in 2m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD12345 status updated -> acknowledged by alice.oncall.

alice.oncall: Adding runbook pointer: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/metering-dedup-incident.md

dave.ingest: After rollback, one thing to watch: backfill may re-introduce duplicates if dedupe index wasn't fixed. I'm starting backfill in idempotent mode with sequence checks.

ben.sre: Uploaded `acme_delta_1998765432.csv` to #billing-ops. Carla please review and advise if we should open a correction invoice or credit route.

carla.billing: Reviewing. If reconciliation shows overcount we'll create a credit and re-run invoices in next billing cycle. Need full scope before customer comms.

alice.oncall: Current severity -> P1 but customer-impacting invoices blocked. Next actions: 1) let backfill finish, 2) confirm dedupe persistence fix in staging and prod, 3) produce reconciliation report + remediation plan, 4) exec ping if >4 customers affected.

ben.sre: Scheduled follow-up: 12:15 UTC incident check-in. Will post update then.

erin.pm: Draft sent to legal + comms. Keep me looped for external statement.

ben.sre: 12:12 UTC update: backfill at 78%, delta for ACME down to +2.1%. Dedupe persistence fix merged to main, release scheduled to canary after verification.

alice.oncall: Thanks team. I'll close the pager when we reach stable metrics and reconciliation accepted by billing.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD12345 status -> resolved by ben.sre (resolver: rollback+backfill) at 12:26 UTC.

carla.billing: Finance: we'll open a one-off credit for ACME pending final audit. No invoices will be issued until confirmation.

ben.sre: Postmortem action items: (1) add commit-after-dedupe guard, (2) add checkpoint monitor alert to detect duplicate ID explosion, (3) add automated invoice hold when delta>5%. Filing followup ticket: INF-5483.

alice.oncall: Great. Handing back to primary owners. I'll update incident channel with postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
